					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1671" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="1" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1671"><p>Anyone with a skill or service to offer can apply as a seller on POBlancer, including independent freelancers, rising talent, and approved POB freelancers. Seller onboarding usually works best when the platform clearly explains who can join and what standards apply to each category.</p></div>
				</div>

					</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1672" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="2" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1672"><p>POBlancer allows different freelancer paths such as Independent Freelancer, Rising Talent Freelancer, POB Internally Trained Freelancer, and POB Experienced Freelancer. These categories help users understand their position on the platform and help clients choose the level of trust, supervision, and experience they want.</p></div>

					<div id="elementor-tab-title-1673" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="3" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1673" aria-expanded="false">

					</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1673" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="3" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1673"><p>POB freelancers are trained, reviewed, and held to stricter quality, professionalism, and conduct standards than public freelancers. Your attached agreements show that POB freelancers are subject to added obligations around confidentiality, quality control, deadlines, client handling, and use of POB systems and brand processes.</p></div>
				</div>

					<div id="elementor-tab-title-1674" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="4" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1674" aria-expanded="false">

					</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1674" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="4" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1674"><p>Yes, beginners can join through the Rising Talent category, which allows growing freelancers to build experience and visibility on the platform. Freelance marketplaces often support newer freelancers as long as expectations, setup, and standards are made clear from the start.</p></div>
				</div>

					</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1675" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="5" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1675"><p>No, not every freelancer needs to be trained by POB before joining the platform. However, anyone who wants to register under a POB-branded category must meet POB’s additional standards and may need approval, training, onboarding, or ongoing review.</p></div>
				</div>

				</div>

					</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1677" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="7" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1677"><p>Yes, POB freelancers must follow stricter rules on conduct, confidentiality, service quality, communication, and brand representation. 				</div>

					</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1679" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="9" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1679"><p>POBlancer gives freelancers a structured place to present services, build trust, and connect with clients looking for digital and creative solutions. Well-run freelance marketplaces improve trust by making profiles, communication, expectations, and service standards easier for both freelancers and clients to understand</p></div>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Effective Date:</strong> 7th May 2026</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">POBlancer, operated by <strong>Princesage Online Branding (POB)</strong>, respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you visit our website, create an account, post a job, apply for work, or use any of our services.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">By using POBlancer, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="1-information-we-collect">1. Information We Collect</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We may collect the following types of information:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Personal Information:</strong> name, email address, phone number, username, password, profile photo, business name, and other details you provide during registration or use of the platform.</li>



<li><strong>Service Information:</strong> job posts, freelancer profiles, proposals, messages, service descriptions, project files, reviews, and payment details.</li>



<li><strong>Technical Information:</strong> IP address, browser type, device information, operating system, log data, and cookies or similar tracking technologies.</li>



<li><strong>Communication Information:</strong> messages, inquiries, complaints, feedback, and support requests sent to us.</li>
</ul>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="2-how-we-use-your-information">2. How We Use Your Information</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We use your information to:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Create and manage your account.</li>



<li>Match freelancers and employers on the platform.</li>



<li>Process job postings, service requests, and transactions.</li>



<li>Communicate with you about your account, projects, or support requests.</li>



<li>Improve our website, services, and user experience.</li>



<li>Prevent fraud, misuse, spam, and unauthorized access.</li>



<li>Enforce our Terms and Conditions and platform rules.</li>



<li>Send service-related notices and, where permitted, promotional updates.</li>
</ul>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="3-how-we-share-information">3. How We Share Information</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information only where necessary, including:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>With <strong>employers and freelancers</strong> as needed to complete a project or communicate about a service.</li>



<li>With <strong>service providers</strong> who help us operate the website, process payments, send emails, host files, or provide security.</li>



<li>With <strong>legal authorities</strong> when required by law, court order, or to protect our rights, users, or business.</li>



<li>With <strong>business partners or affiliates</strong> where required for service delivery or platform operation.</li>
</ul>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="4-cookies-and-tracking">4. Cookies and Tracking</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We may use cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences, improve site performance, analyze traffic, and enhance your experience. You can control cookies through your browser settings, but some parts of the platform may not function properly if cookies are disabled.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="5-data-security">5. Data Security</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the internet or method of electronic storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="6-data-retention">6. Data Retention</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We retain your information for as long as necessary to provide our services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, enforce our agreements, and support legitimate business needs.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="7-your-rights">7. Your Rights</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have the right to:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Access your personal information.</li>



<li>Request correction of inaccurate information.</li>



<li>Request deletion of certain information.</li>



<li>Object to or restrict certain processing.</li>



<li>Withdraw consent where applicable.</li>
</ul>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="8-third-party-links">8. Third-Party Links</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our platform may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or security of those third-party platforms.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="9-childrens-privacy">9. Children’s Privacy</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">POBlancer is not intended for children under 18, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from minors without appropriate consent where required by law.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="10-changes-to-this-policy">10. Changes to This Policy</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. Continued use of the platform after changes means you accept the revised policy.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="11-contact-us">11. Contact Us</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, you may contact us at:</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Princesage Online Branding (POB)</strong><br>No. 4 Majaro Street, Onike, Sabo, Lagos, Nigeria<br><strong>Email:</strong> freelancer@pob.ng</p>

<h1 class="wp-block-heading" id="return-policy"></h1>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Effective Date:</strong> 7th May 2026</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This Return Policy explains how refunds, cancellations, corrections, and service reversals are handled on POBlancer. Because POBlancer is a service-based platform, this policy applies mainly to project payments, service delivery, and disputes rather than physical product returns.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">By placing a project, hiring a freelancer, or purchasing a service on POBlancer, you agree to this Return Policy in addition to our Terms and Conditions.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="1-service-based-nature">1. Service-Based Nature</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">POBlancer provides digital and freelance services. Because services are intangible and often begin immediately after agreement, not all transactions are eligible for full refunds. Refunds are reviewed based on the stage of work, the nature of the issue, and the agreement between the client and freelancer.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="2-when-a-refund-may-be-considered">2. When a Refund May Be Considered</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">A refund may be considered if:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>The freelancer failed to start the agreed work within the approved timeframe.</li>



<li>The freelancer did not deliver the agreed service.</li>



<li>The delivered work is materially different from the agreed scope.</li>



<li>The freelancer abandoned the project without valid reason.</li>



<li>The project was canceled before meaningful work began.</li>



<li>There was a serious breach of platform rules, fraud, or misconduct.</li>
</ul>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="3-when-a-refund-may-not-be-available">3. When a Refund May Not Be Available</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">A refund may not be granted if:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>The work was already completed according to the agreed brief.</li>



<li>The client changed the scope after work had started.</li>



<li>The client failed to respond, approve, or supply required information on time.</li>



<li>The issue is based on personal preference after approved delivery.</li>



<li>The service has been partially or fully used.</li>



<li>The project was completed under a separate signed agreement that limits refunds.</li>
</ul>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="4-corrections-and-revisions">4. Corrections and Revisions</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Before any refund is considered, POBlancer may allow corrections, revisions, or rework where appropriate. Many service issues can be resolved by fixing the deliverable rather than reversing the full payment. Our goal is to protect both clients and freelancers while keeping projects moving fairly.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="5-dispute-review">5. Dispute Review</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">If a client is not satisfied with a service, the matter should first be reported to POBlancer for review. We may request files, messages, screenshots, proof of delivery, or other supporting details before making a decision.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="6-payment-processing-and-bank-charges">6. Payment Processing and Bank Charges</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Where a refund is approved, any payment processor fees, bank charges, or transfer costs may be deducted from the refunded amount depending on the payment method and the circumstances of the transaction.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="7-freelancer-responsibility">7. Freelancer Responsibility</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">If a refund is caused by freelancer fault, POBlancer may recover the relevant amount from the freelancer’s payout, reserve, or agreed commission structure, where applicable and lawful.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="8-processing-time">8. Processing Time</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Approved refunds are processed within a reasonable time after review. Processing time may vary depending on the payment method, bank, and transaction method used.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="9-contact-for-refund-requests">9. Contact for Refund Requests</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">To request a refund or raise a service dispute, contact:</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Email:</strong> freelancer@pob.ng<br><strong>Business Name:</strong> Princesage Online Branding (POB)<br><strong>Address:</strong> No. 4 Majaro Street, Onike, Sabo, Lagos, Nigeria</p>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-2483" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="3" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-2483"><p>POB freelancers are trained, reviewed, and held to stricter quality, professionalism, and conduct standards than public freelancers. Your attached agreements show that POB freelancers are subject to added obligations around confidentiality, quality control, deadlines, client handling, and use of POB systems and brand processes.</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
					<div id="elementor-tab-title-2484" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="4" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-2484" aria-expanded="false">
													<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
														</span>
												<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">4. Can beginners join POBlancer?</a>
					</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-2484" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="4" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-2484"><p>Yes, beginners can join through the Rising Talent category, which allows growing freelancers to build experience and visibility on the platform. Freelance marketplaces often support newer freelancers as long as expectations, setup, and standards are made clear from the start.</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
					<div id="elementor-tab-title-2485" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="5" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-2485" aria-expanded="false">
													<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
														</span>
												<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">5. Do I need to be trained by POB before joining?</a>
					</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-2485" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="5" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-2485"><p>No, not every freelancer needs to be trained by POB before joining the platform. However, anyone who wants to register under a POB-branded category must meet POB’s additional standards and may need approval, training, onboarding, or ongoing review.</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
					<div id="elementor-tab-title-2486" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="6" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-2486" aria-expanded="false">
													<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
														</span>
												<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">6. How do I start selling my services?</a>
					</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-2486" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="6" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-2486"><p><br />Create your account, choose the correct freelancer category, complete your profile, and set up your services professionally. Seller onboarding best practices emphasize keeping the setup clear and helping sellers become ready to offer services quickly.Content</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
					<div id="elementor-tab-title-2487" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="7" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-2487" aria-expanded="false">
													<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
														</span>
												<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">7. Are POB freelancers required to follow extra rules?</a>
					</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-2487" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="7" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-2487"><p>Yes, POB freelancers must follow stricter rules on conduct, confidentiality, service quality, communication, and brand representation. The attached agreements also include rules around private client dealings, POB content, deadlines, and accountability for poor workmanship or brand damage</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
					<div id="elementor-tab-title-2488" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="8" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-2488" aria-expanded="false">
													<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
														</span>
												<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">8. Do POB freelancers need to sign an agreement?</a>
					</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-2488" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="8" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-2488"><p><br />Yes, POB Internally Trained Freelancers and POB Experienced Freelancers should select their respective category on the sign up page and download the agreement letter that matches their category. Complete it, and send it to freelancer@pob.ng. This helps formalize expectations around standards, obligations, and working relationships under the POB brand.</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
					<div id="elementor-tab-title-2489" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="9" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-2489" aria-expanded="false">
													<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
														</span>
												<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">9. Why should I sell on POBlancer?</a>
					</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-2489" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="9" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-2489"><p>POBlancer gives freelancers a structured place to present services, build trust, and connect with clients looking for digital and creative solutions. Well-run freelance marketplaces improve trust by making profiles, communication, expectations, and service standards easier for both freelancers and clients to understand</p></div>
				</div>

					</div>
